{{Current events|year=2018|month=01|day=17|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Two [[Americans]] and two [[Canadians]] are abducted by unknown gunmen in [[Kaduna State]], [[Nigeria]]. Two police officers are killed after engaging in a firefight with the abductors. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-kidnapping/kidnappers-abduct-two-americans-two-canadians-in-nigeria-two-police-killed-idUSKBN1F61XS (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Suspected [[Boko Haram]] suicide bombers kill 12 people and injure 48 others, in [[Maiduguri]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/suspected-boko-haram-suicide-bombers-kill-12-injure-48-idUSKBN1F627C?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in the North Caucasus]]
**In [[Nazran]], [[Ingushetia]], arsonists set fire to the office of [[Memorial (society)|Memorial]], a [[Russia]]n human rights organization. [https://themoscowtimes.com/news/masked-arsonists-torch-memorial-human-rights-office-in-north-caucasus-60201 (''The Moscow Times'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[France–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[Bayeux Tapestry]], which depicts the [[Norman conquest of England]], is to be displayed in the [[United Kingdom]] for the first time after [[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] agreed to loan it out for the first time in 950 years. Subject to the outcome of tests, the loan is expected to happen somewhere after 2020. [http://www.bbc.com/news/uk-42713552 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Sapphire Aviation Bell UH-1H Iroquois crash]]
**Zimbabwean politician [[Roy Bennett (politician)|Roy Bennett]] is killed in a helicopter crash near [[Raton, New Mexico]], United States. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-42749583 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**The South Korean [[Ministry of Unification]] announces that both [[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] will march together under the [[Korean Unification Flag]] during the [[2018 Winter Olympics opening ceremony|opening ceremony]] of the [[2018 Winter Olympics]]. [http://edition.cnn.com/2018/01/17/asia/north-south-korea-olympics-flag-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Visa policy of the United States]]
**The [[U.S. Department of Homeland Security]] discontinues the eligibility of citizens of [[Belize]], [[Haiti]], and [[Samoa]] to obtain [[H-2A visa|H-2A]] and [[H-2B visa|H-2B]] visas for temporary work. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-haiti/trump-administration-bars-haitians-from-u-s-visas-for-low-skilled-work-idUSKBN1F702O (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Freedom of the press]], [[Media of the Philippines]]
**Following the [[Securities and Exchange Commission (Philippines)|Securities and Exchange Commission of the Philippines]]' revocation of [[Rappler]]'s license, the [[National Bureau of Investigation (Philippines)|National Bureau of Investigation of the Philippines]] launches a probe into Rappler. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-media/philippines-orders-further-probes-into-news-site-that-angered-duterte-idUSKBN1F61J1 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections	
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]	
**The [[Parliament of Catalonia]] opens the new [[Catalan regional election, 2017|legislature]]. [[Roger Torrent]] ([[Republican Left of Catalonia|ERC]]) is named [[List of Presidents of the Parliament of Catalonia|Speaker]]. Three parliamentarians in jail [[Proxy voting|vote through proxies]], the five parlementarians in [[exile]] in Belgium do not. [[Carles Puigdemont]] ([[Catalan European Democratic Party|PDeCAT]], [[Junts per Catalunya|JuntsxCat]]), through his spokesman, considers it "perfectly plausible" for him to be [[President of the Generalitat of Catalonia|president]] remotely. Spanish [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Mariano Rajoy]] says that he will not [[Article 155|restore Catalonia's autonomous powers]] if the regional parliament permits Puigdemont to lead the government from exile. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42718192 (BBC)]
*[[Freedom of the press]], [[Fake News Awards]]
**[[Donald Trump]] tweets a link to the Republican National Committee's "[[Fake News Awards]]", won by ten stories and tweets that he considers misreported. The link also honors ten ways the President "has been getting results" thus far. [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/17/trump-fake-news-awards-345482 (Politico)]
